name: Proffer Abjuration (Metamagic)
body:
You have learned how to pass your abjurations on to others.

Prerequisite: Caster level 6th

Benefit: A number of times per day equal to 1 + you’re primary casting ability modifier, you can pass any non-personal abjuration spell from which you currently benefit to any willing or helpless creature (SR applies). The duration of this effect does not change and you lose all benefits of the spell.
